blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) urged protesters to show Filipino hospitality toward foreign delegates and keep their demonstrations peaceful during the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits. “Filipinos are known for our hospitality and respect for our guests,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said in a statement on Sunday. “We can disagree with their leaders and their policies, but let us express those differences peacefully and responsibly because our freedom to protest should never come at the expense of our values as a people,” he added.
